description_en: Obtains specified job sanity check result in a Deep Learning Containers (DLC) job
description_zh: 获取DLC任务某次算力健康检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc get-job-sanity-check-result --job-id dlcl5qxoxxxxx5iq --sanity-check-number 1 --sanity-check-phase DeviceCheck --token eyJhbG000000zI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJle0000jE3MDk1Mzk0NDIsImlhdCI6MTcwODkzNDY0MiwidXNlcl9pZCI6IjE3NTgwNTQxNjI0Mzg2NTUiLCJ0YXJnZXRfaWQiOiJkbGM1OGh1a2xyYzZwdGMyIiwidGFyZ2V0X3R5cGUiOiJqb2IifQ.GNL7jo60000mgKKv0QeGIYgvBufSU-PH_EQttX0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobSanityCheckResult

parameters.help_en: The job ID. For more information about how to obtain a job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The nth time for which the job sanity check is performed
parameters.help_zh: 任务第几次算力健康检测
parameters.name: sanity_check_number

parameters.help_en:
The phase in which the job sanity check is performed.

*   CheckInit
*   DeviceCheck
*   SingleNodeCommCheck
*   TwoNodeCommCheck
*   AllNodeCommCheck
parameters.help_zh:
算力健康检测的检测阶段：
- CheckInit：检测环境准备。
- DeviceCheck：单卡算力检测。
- SingleNodeCommCheck：单节点内部通信检测。
- TwoNodeCommCheck：两节点间通信检测。
- AllNodeCommCheck：所有节点通信检测
parameters.name: sanity_check_phase

parameters.help_en: The token information for job sharing. For more information about how to obtain the token information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557812.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务分享令牌中的Token信息。如何获取，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557812.html
parameters.name: token
